127
RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Monday, September 5, 2011/Bhadra 14, 1933 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Coal; Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution;
Corporate Affairs; Earth Sciences; Information and Broadcasting;
Law and Justice; Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises; Mines;
Minority Affairs; New and Renewable Energy; Parliamentary
Affairs; Power; Science and Technology; Water Resources)
Total number of questions — 20
National Mineral Policy
*441. SHRI DHIRAJ PRASAD SAHU:
Will the Minister of MINES be pleased to
state:
(a) whether a National Mineral Policy
is being formulated;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether unorganised mines are being
brought under the proposed Policy; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and the
criteria for selection of such unorganised
mines?
CPSUs under the Ministry
*442. SHRI O.T. LEPCHA: Will the
Minister of SCIENCE AND
TECHNOLOGY be pleased to state:
(a) the names and locations of the Central
Public Sector Undertakings working under
the Ministry;
(b) the number of contract/casual
labourers appointed therein during the last
three years;
(c) the areas/jobs in which these
labourers were appointed;
(d) the number of such labourers who
were regularized during the last three years;
(e) the mechanism adopted to ensure
minimum wages to these workers;
(f) the mechanism adopted to ensure that
the provisions of various labour laws are
not violated by contractors and others; and
(g) the actions taken in case of
complaints and violations by contractors
and others?
Protection of old dams
*443. DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of W A TER RESOURCES
be pleased to state:
(a) the number of dams in India that are
more than 100 years old;
(b) the steps taken by Government for
protection of these old dams;
(c) the funds allocated and spent for
this purpose during the last three years,
State-wise;

128
(d) whether Andhra Pradesh
Government has sent any proposal in this
regard; and
(e) if so, the details thereof and the action
taken thereon?
River linking scheme
*444. DR. RAM PRAKASH: Will the
Minister of W ATER RESOURCES be
pleased to state:
(a) the status of river linking scheme in
the country;
(b) the rivers which would be under this
network in Haryana;
(c) how much is the budget and how
much has already been spent till December,
2010, project-wise; and
(d) whether the river linking scheme is
viable these days?
Scrapping of Urdu television serials
*445. SHRI JAI PRAKASH
NARAYAN SINGH: Will the Minister of
INFORMATION AND
BROADCASTING be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that duly
approved/selected television serials for
Urdu channel of Doordarshan have been
scrapped by the acting Chief Executive
Officer of Prasar Bharati;
(b) if so, the reasons and justification
therefor; and
(c) whether any responsibility has been
fixed on erring officers for scrapping of these
serials and, if not, the reasons therefor?
Contribution of MSMEs to GDP
*446. SHRI A VINASH PANDE: Will
the Minister of MICRO, SMALL AND
MEDIUM ENTERPRISES be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government has estimated
the output/contribution of Micro, Small
and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) to
Gross Domestic Product (GDP) during the
last three years;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government is planning to
introduce priority based procurement from
MSMEs for boosting their growth and
contribution to GDP;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) what other measures have been taken
by Government for boosting growth of
MSMEs?
Rural electrification targets
*447. DR. BHALCHANDRA
MUNGEKAR: Will the Minister of
POWER be pleased to state:
(a) the targets set for electrification of
villages and poor households in the country
during 2009-10 and 2010-11 and how much
of it has been achieved till date;
(b) the major reasons for gaps, if any, in
targets and achievements; and
(c) the steps Government is taking to
speed up the process of implementation
so that these  targets can be achieved within
the stipulated time-frame?
Misleading advertisements
*448. PROF. ANIL KUMAR
SAHANI: Will the Minister of
CONSUMER AFFAIRS, FOOD AND
PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION be pleased to
state:
(a) whether some companies like
Himani, Hindustan Unilever, Himalaya,
Complan, etc. are marketing fairness
creams, dandruff removal shampoos, etc.
misguiding their customers by broadcasting

129

misleading advertisements on television,
etc.; and
(b) whether there is any proposal to
verify the claims of these companies to
check the effectiveness of their products
and to book unscrupulous companies for
misleading advertisements and misguiding
the consumers?

DHINDSA: Will the Minister of POWER
be pleased to state:

power consumption in the country is much
